title: Bohrium + SciMaster: Building the Infrastructure and Ecosystem for Agentic Science at Scale
summary: Argues that scalable scientific agents require agent-ready infrastructure, stable tool interfaces, execution traces, reproducibility, governance, and workflow-level feedback loops.

title: SciMaster: Towards General-Purpose Scientific AI Agents, Part I. X-Master as Foundation
summary: Introduces a tool-augmented reasoning agent and a scattered-and-stacked workflow that scales scientific problem solving through tool use and inference-time compute.

title: OmniScience: A Large-scale Multi-modal Dataset for Scientific Image Understanding
summary: Describes a large scientific image-text-context dataset built from parsed open-access scientific documents, useful as an evidence substrate for scientific agents.

title: Fluoroethylene Carbonate and Vinylene Carbonate Reduction: Understanding Lithium-Ion Battery Electrolyte Additives and Solid Electrolyte Interphase Formation
summary: Studies FEC and VC reduction products and relates their chemistry to solid-electrolyte-interphase formation in lithium-ion battery electrolytes.

title: Insights into the efficient roles of solid electrolyte interphase derived from vinylene carbonate additive in rechargeable batteries
summary: Reviews VC-derived SEI layers and summarizes why VC is widely used as a film-forming additive in rechargeable batteries.

title: How electrolyte additives work in Li-ion batteries
summary: Discusses mechanistic roles of representative electrolyte additives and why additive chemistry remains difficult to optimize without systematic evidence.

title: Investigation of lithium ion battery electrolytes containing flame retardants in combination with film forming electrolyte additives
summary: Examines combinations of safety additives and film-forming additives, highlighting the need to balance safety and electrochemical performance.
